title: SYNTHETIC: In vitro study of SYN-1 inhibition in a Disease-D cell model

sections.heading: Summary
sections.text: Inhibition of the synthetic target SYN-1 reduced the disease marker M by 62% in cultured Disease-D model cells compared with vehicle (n=6 per group). This document is entirely synthetic and describes no real compound, target or disease.

sections.heading: Genetic evidence
sections.text: A synthetic cohort analysis associated loss-of-function variants in SYN1 with lower marker M levels. The analysis is correlative and does not establish causality.

sections.heading: Limitations
sections.text: Experiments were performed in a single cell line. No in vivo data are included in this document.
